playArea.value: A radioactive atom with jiggling nucleons sits in the center. You can watch it decay, observe how the nucleus changes, and reset the atom to repeat your experiment. A timeline shows the moment of each decay relative to half-life.

energyGraph.value: An energy diagram shows the potential energy barrier and alpha particle energy. With a custom isotope, you can experiment with the barrier height, alpha particle energy, and half-life.

controlArea.value: You can replay the last decay and control how fast the action happens. Reset sim to start over.

playArea.value: You can add atoms to a radioactive sample and watch them decay. As time passes, you can track how much remains and reset the sample to repeat your experiment. A timeline shows the moment of each decay relative to the half-life. With a custom isotope, you can also experiment with the half-life time.

controlArea.value: Checkboxes let you show or hide the electron cloud and stopwatch. You can control how fast the action happens including buttons to pause and step forward. Reset sim to start over.

}

noAtoms.value: No atoms in sample. Look for { $isotope } atoms control to get started.

readyToDecay.value: Original sample contains { $addedAtoms } { $isotope } atoms, ready to decay.

decayOccurring.value: Original sample contains { $addedAtoms } { $isotope } atoms. { $decayParticle } particles are emitted from decaying atoms and move away. Currently, sample is { $time } seconds old and { $percentageUndecayed } percent remains. { $undecayedCount } { $isotope } atoms undecayed. { $decayedCount } { $isotope } atoms decayed.
